notes: I replaced the discrete "small positive x -> -6.9015" rule with a continuous ramp from -7.9 (at x=0) up to -6.9 (at x≥T), since E2's x=1.2 gave -7.7016 — a value between the two plateaus, contradicting the old fixed -6.9015. The threshold T is uncertain because E1 and E2 imply different slopes; I picked a compromise and marked it with "?".
